citations.assessment: The midrash has bar Marion in the statement on the divine sword.
The exposition of the Song of Songs verse explicitly names bar Marion.
Bivi, Aivu and Huna transmit bar Marion, with the first two in the converse order from Heilprin.
Both named transmitters appear with bar Marion in the comparison of the ancestors and descendants.
Yirmeyah, Abbahu and Yitzḥak bar Marion occur in that order in a compact chain in Ḥanina’s name.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

holds.reason: Bereshit Rabbah and Ruth Rabbah give a nearby alternate attribution involving Yose bar Ḥanina in the Sanhedrin exposition. The exact wording and direction implied in Heilprin remain uncertain.
The checked Psalm 103 material and Yalkut passages did not supply an exact bar Marion transmission from Resh Lakish. Keep the source citation visible.
